SELECT
  fclt_organization.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY AS DLC_ORG_KEY,
  fclt_organization.DLC_NAME,
  fclt_building.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS BUILDING_KEY,
  fclt_building.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  fclt_building_address.STREET_NUMBER,
  fclt_building_address.STREET_NUMBER_SUFFIX,
  fclt_building_address.PRE_DIRECTIONAL,
  fclt_building_address.STREET_NAME,
  fclt_building_address.STREET_SUFFIX,
  fclt_building_address.POST_DIRECTIONAL,
  fclt_building_address.CITY,
  fclt_building_address.STATE,
  fclt_building_address.POSTAL_CODE,
  fclt_building_address.ADDRESS_PURPOSE,
  fclt_building_address.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS ADDRESS_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE,
  fclt_building.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS BUILDING_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE

JOIN fclt_building
  ON fclt_organization.DLC_KEY = fclt_building.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY OR fclt_organization.DLC_KEY = fclt_building.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fclt_building_address
  ON fclt_building.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fclt_building_address.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY

  LOWER(fclt_organization.DLC_NAME) = LOWER('History')
  AND fclt_building_address.ADDRESS_PURPOSE = 'STREET'

chunk_view_4_10.name: chunk_view_4_10
chunk_view_4_10.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.SUBJECT_TITLE,
  m.TITLE AS MATERIAL_TITLE,
  m.ISBN,
  td.RECORD_COUNT AS MATERIAL_QUANTITY,
  m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE,
  -- total cost as quantity * unit price; keep as expression for later aggregation/validation
  (td.RECORD_COUNT * m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS TOTAL_COST,
  -- keys for joins later
  s.SUBJECT_SUMMARY_KEY,
  s.TERM_CODE,
  m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY,
  td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY,
  td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
FROM tip_detail td
JOIN tip_material m
  ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY
JOIN tip_subject_offered tso
  ON td.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
JOIN subject_offered s
  ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID
     AND tso.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE
WHERE
  -- only consider materials that have an ISBN
  td.ISBN IS NOT NULL
  AND td.ISBN <> ''
  -- material is marked as new by using NEW_SHELF_PRICE presence or TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS indicating 'new'
  AND (m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE IS NOT NULL
       OR td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NOT NULL)

SELECT
  -- building identifiers and names to allow joining with other chunks/tables
  fclt_building.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
  fclt_building.BUILDING_NAME,
  fclt_building.BUILDING_NUMBER,
  -- floor columns that indicate floor value; keep floor key for joins
  fclt_floor.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY,
  fclt_floor.FLOOR,
  fclt_floor.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AS floor_building_key,
  -- also include fac_floor in case floors are recorded there in this chunk
  fac_floor.FLOOR_KEY AS fac_floor_key,
  fac_floor.BUILDING_KEY AS fac_floor_building_key,
  fac_floor.FLOOR AS fac_floor_floor,
  fac_floor.LEVEL_ID,
  -- include fac_building identifiers/names as alternative building table in this chunk
  fac_building.FAC_BUILDING_KEY,
  fac_building.BUILDING_NAME AS fac_building_name,
  fac_building.BUILDING_NUMBER AS fac_building_number
FROM fclt_building
LEFT JOIN fclt_floor
  ON fclt_floor.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fclt_building.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_floor
  ON fac_floor.BUILDING_KEY = fclt_building.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_building
  ON fac_building.FAC_BUILDING_KEY = fclt_building.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WHERE
  -- keep only rows where at least one floor value is defined in this chunk

chunk_view_1_44.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- building component identifier/name: use BUILDING_WINGS_ID or BUILDING_NUMBER where available
  fclt_floor.BUILDING_WINGS_ID AS building_component_id,
  -- building name from building tables
  COALESCE(fclt_building.BUILDING_NAME, fac_building.BUILDING_NAME, fclt_building.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fac_building.BUILDING_NAME_LONG) AS building_name,
  -- room square footage at room granularity
  fac_rooms.AREA AS room_area,
  -- building-level totals that can be derived from this chunk:
  -- total number of floors for the building (count distinct floor keys in fclt_floor / fac_floor)
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ff.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY)
   FROM fclt_floor ff
   WHERE ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fclt_floor.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  ) AS total_floors_in_building,
  -- total number of rooms for the building (use NUM_OF_ROOMS from fac_building / fclt_building if present)
  COALESCE(fclt_building.NUM_OF_ROOMS, fac_building.NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS total_rooms_in_building,
  -- total number of facility organizations associated with the building (count distinct organizations where BUILDING_KEY matches in fac_rooms)
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fr.ORGANIZATION_KEY)
   FROM fac_rooms fr
   WHERE fr.BUILDING_KEY = COALESCE(fclt_building.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fac_building.FAC_BUILDING_KEY)
  ) AS total_facility_organizations_for_building,
  -- total number of supervisors and supervisees: this chunk does not include explicit supervisor relationships.
  -- include placeholders by counting distinct ORGANIZATION_KEY that might represent supervisors/supervisees where available.
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fr.MAJOR_USE_KEY)
   FROM fac_rooms fr
   WHERE fr.BUILDING_KEY = COALESCE(fclt_building.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fac_building.FAC_BUILDING_KEY)
  ) AS total_supervisors_like_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fr.MINOR_ORGANIZATION_KEY)
   FROM fac_rooms fr
   WHERE fr.BUILDING_KEY = COALESCE(fclt_building.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fac_building.FAC_BUILDING_KEY)
  ) AS total_supervisees_like_count,
  -- keys for joining later
  fclt_floor.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY,
  fclt_floor.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY,
  fac_rooms.FAC_ROOM_KEY,
  fac_rooms.BUILDING_KEY AS fac_rooms_building_key,
  fac_rooms.FLOOR_KEY AS fac_rooms_floor_key
FROM fclt_floor
-- left join to building tables to get building names and counts where available
LEFT JOIN fclt_building ON fclt_floor.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fclt_building.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
LEFT JOIN fac_building ON fclt_floor.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fac_building.FAC_BUILDING_KEY OR fclt_floor.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fac_building.FAC_BUILDING_KEY
-- join rooms to get room-area at room granularity; ensure rooms are for this floor/component
LEFT JOIN fac_rooms ON ( (fac_rooms.FLOOR_KEY = fclt_floor.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY) OR (fac_rooms.FLOOR = fclt_floor.FLOOR) )

SELECT

  COUNT(DISTINCT tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS NUM_TYPES_OF_TIP_SUBJECTS_OFFERED,
  -- aggregated materials needed: collect distinct TIP material ISBNs (from tip_material via tip_detail relation). Concatenate distinct ISBNs.
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tm.ISBN ORDER BY tm.ISBN SEPARATOR ', ') AS MATERIALS_NEEDED,
  -- min/max enrolled students across TIP subject offerings (from tip_subject_offered.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS)
  MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS MIN_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
  MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
  -- number of distinct schools offering TIP subjects in the term (from tip_subject_offered.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME)
  COUNT(DISTINCT tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS NUM_SCHOOLS_OFFERING_SUBJECTS,
  -- total records: total tip_detail rows for the term

  hr_org_unit_new.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY AS hr_org_unit_new_key,

  fclt_organization_hist.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
